about: D12 (design/WARRANT.md, ruled 2026-10-29): one hero figure per page. This registry covers the Tier 1 pages of WARRANT.md's site pass (2026-10-28), keyed by their path under site/. Each row is exactly one of: "hero": true (the built page declares it, data-hero); "none": why the page has no hero; "pending": why it waits, allowed for an app only (the landing and apps/<name>/). `name` is the page as WARRANT.md's Tier 1 line names it. tools/check-wiring.js reads this file against that line and against the built pages: a Tier 1 page with no row, a row with no reason, a stale row, or a pending report refuses.

index.html.name: the home page
index.html.none: no figure: the landing's first screen is the one description, the register's four stats and the cards of what came back from outside; batch 2 declares existing figures only (proposed for a later batch: the register's decided claims as cells by verdict, the gsm8k strip's form, each refuted claim's witness drawn as a × on its own cell)

machine/index.html.name: Method
machine/index.html.none: no figure: how a claim becomes a certificate is told in prose and a table; batch 1 declares existing figures only, and a hero here would have to be drawn first

janela/index.html.name: Janela
janela/index.html.none: the map is the page: an app-shell surface (design/app-shell.js, 100% x 100dvh, the map fixed under every panel) has no container for a figure to draw past and no .figbox, and its drawings are canvases over a basemap (the crests, the wind, the marks), so the hero rule does not belong in the app shell

swell/index.html.name: Swell
swell/index.html.none: the map is the page: an app-shell surface (design/app-shell.js, 100% x 100dvh, the island map fixed under every panel) has no container for a figure to draw past and no .figbox, and its drawings are canvases (the flow, the wind, the day strip, the timeline), so the hero rule does not belong in the app shell

explained/index.html.name: explained
explained/index.html.none: its natural hero is the cold open's stage, the claims flying through DECIDE, which is HTML and CSS motion labelled as only a picture, not an SVG in .figbox; the one .figbox figure, the route of a claim, is a schematic held to 800 px (.mach) that a wider box would not widen (proposed: the stage redrawn as a figure, its flight under D13's rule)
